class.name: FmodAudioEffectAmplify
class.brief_description: A simple gain/volume effect for amplifying or attenuating audio signals.
class.description: FmodAudioEffectAmplify is a basic gain control effect that increases or decreases the volume of the audio signal. It provides both decibel (dB) and linear control over the amplification level. Use this effect for simple volume adjustments, boosting quiet signals, or attenuating loud signals in your audio pipeline.

members.member: The amplification level in decibels (dB). Range: -80 dB to +24 dB. Default value of 0 dB means no change to the signal. Negative values attenuate the signal, positive values amplify it. The current conversion helper produces silence at -60 dB and below.

The amplification level as a linear value. A value of 1.0 is unity gain. The setter floors values at 0.001 before converting to [member volume_db]; inputs at or below this floor map to -60 dB. The getter returns 0.0 for stored gains at or below -60 dB, so setting 0.0 produces silence. The maximum stored gain of +24 dB corresponds to approximately 15.8489.
